Centered bounded innovations have conditional variance tending uniformly to 1 on n^(2/3) windows; martingale functional CLT gives the two-sided Brownian local process. Quantitative Doob bounds plus dyadic annulus estimates localize all argmaxes; matching-switching Azuma controls the outer cuts. Unique Brownian-parabola maximizer yields the stated joint weak limit. The standalone standard-library verifier independently passed 195 exact assertions for all matchings up to 12 endpoints; this checks finite identities, not the infinite limit.

value.rationale: The busiest location of a fixed-order pairing scan is a canonical geometric/algorithmic optimum, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The published global Gaussian bridge gives order-sqrt(n) centered fluctuations but leaves the maximizing location invisible; the joint n^(2/3)-displacement and n^(1/3)-excess limit quantifies precisely the optimizer and its random advantage. The scale and constant are specific to the constrained matching model, and the new local and global control are substantive.
